review_summary.college_name: Camellia Institute of Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Good for learning and best for placements.

content.Placements: A minimum of 80% of students got placed on the college campus. We got near about 4 to 8 lacs approximately. Tata Voltas, Bajaj electrical, Wipro, TCS and Capgemini also come to our college. 20% of students are going to join internships in TCS and Wipro. Embedded engineer, software developer, and production line control engineer posts are offered.
content.Infrastructure: Full Wi-Fi is available on our college campus and hostel also. Some smart classrooms and digital practical rooms are also available in our college with a central library. One universal canteen is available in our college for all students. Teaching and non-teaching staff provide good quality food, and our college hostel canteen is available in our hostel too. Two tennis courts and one football ground are available. No medical department is available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Teachers here are very good, and the campus is also very good.

content.Placements: Camellia School of Engineering and Technology is a very good college for engineering, and its campus is also very good. Our college also offered a diploma in civil and mechanical engineering. Discipline is the most priority of our college. So students are very good and disciplined.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are also very good here. The quality of food served is nice.
content.Faculty: Teachers here are very good, very helpful and friendly. They always help us with our problems. They are highly qualified, creative and knowledgeable. The teaching quality of our teachers is awesome. This course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students industry-ready. The semester exams of our college are very difficult and hard. The pass percentage of our college is 85%.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: It is the best engineering college with good faculty members, infrastructure and proper placements.

content.Placements: Most of the students got placed on-campus. Some top companies come to hire students. Most of the students are satisfied with the campusing. Most of the companies are IT companies and the salary packages offered are good for freshers.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good. The classrooms are very clean. But the college hostel is a bit away from the college but there is no food problem in the hostel. The food served is good in the hostel and the college canteen. But the college should open a fast food shop which will be very useful.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Overall our college is good.

content.Placements: About 75% of the students get placed. The highest salary package offered was 24 LPA. The lowest salary offered is Rs. 72,000 per annum. Flipkart is the top recruiting company. Roles of installing and maintain wiring, control, and lighting system are offered. There were companies which conducted the entry-level exam in our college, but none of them got selected.
content.Infrastructure: All facilities are available here, and they are good. The institute has magnificently designed separate hostels for boys and girls each with all modern facilities. The hostel has its own mess to provide good and hygiene food to students. The college keeps close contact with some local medical pharmacy.

individual_reviews.course: - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: Review of Camellia School of Engineering and Technology (CSET).

content.Placements: Very poor placements. During our batch, almost 95% of the batch graduated without getting offers from companies. And this wasn't because of the poor quality of students. Rather, it was about the incapability of the college authorities to win the confidence of companies. With very poor infrastructure, it was more about duping the students than providing them education.
content.Infrastructure: Very poor set up of college. Half the college continues to be under construction even after 10 years of foundation. And instead of completing the existing setup, the authorities keep adding courses and seats every year in pursuit of earning money. The entire college seems like a ravaged place with outcast students finding a place.

The 18th floor is for boys hostels, the 17th floor is for girls hostels on the Newtown campus and the 8th floor is for girls hostels on the Park Circus campus, with food and lodging monthly.

reviews.review_heading: Its the best university in west Bengal.
reviews.review_text: Aliah University has the best hostels in west Bengal. Every room is well decorated. You will also get a personal study table beside your Bed. You also have the opportunity in sports if you are interested. There is also a canteen on this campus and the food quality is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Aliah University.
reviews.review_text: All labs, library, and classrooms are clean. The library is Wi-Fi enabled, and plenty of books are available, which are very useful for students of every course. The hostel and canteen facilities are excellent. Medical facilities are available at our university.

reviews.review_heading: Aliah sets a record in the academic field.
reviews.review_text: The campus has a multi-storeyed building in the heart of Kolkata. It is enabled with free Wi-Fi facility. It has CCTV cameras. Laboratories and a library with a digital library are available. Sprawling and airy classrooms are available. A computer room is available in each department. Table tennis and carrom room are available. Food available in the canteen is edible and affordable. The girls' hostel is Wi-Fi enabled. Many other facilities are available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: The college has amazing infrastructure and good faculty members.
reviews.review_text: 24-hours Wi-Fi facility is available on the campus. There are modern instruments in labs. The library is modern as it is opened until 8 pm. The classrooms are amazing. There are two doctors, and also there is a nursing department. Every year, the annual sports and indoor games are held on the campus. The quality of food in the canteen is good, and the food is also available after 12 am. Behind the university and in Chingrighata, there is a girls hostel. Boys hostel is in Newtown.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Aliah University -City Campus (Park Circus).
reviews.review_text: Our Park circus Aliah University campus is amazing, wonderful, and designed beautifully. In our University lab facilities, central library, modern classroom, free Wi-Fi everything is available. Hostel available in New Town campus, both girls and boys hostel situated in New Town campus.

reviews.review_heading: Aliah University: Why You Will Choose And Why You Will Not.
reviews.review_text: If you come and see the campus for the first time, for sure, you will be stunned and misjudge it with shopping mall or any corporate office! Labs classrooms library are just awesome and a new canteen is being made. You will definitely love the front and the space of the campus. A girls' hostel is just got finished and will be opened for next session. The rooms in the hostel are also very decent and I'm sure you will think it as of any 2/3 star hotel room! Well why am I saying that? ! Because the...

reviews.review_heading: Aliah University offers good education and a campus, but the placement scope is limited.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms are well-structured. Many fans, tubelights, chairs, and tables are present in our classroom. A library is present in our department, with various types of books available. Hostel quality is also good, and food availability is good. Medical facilities are well-equipped.

individual_reviews.title: One stop for Dr NTR College of Agricultural Engineering.

content.Placements: The major hiring companies in this college are Mahindra, Tafe, and Dhan Foundation. Out of 60 batches, 10 got placed in Mahindra and Tafe, 20 in Dhan, and rest of prepared for competitive exams like GATE or CAT. The salary packages offered by Mahindra and Tafe are almost 6 LPA and Dhan offered a salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college is definitely the best part of it, with old buildings and new ones smaller than that of my high schools. But, facilities provided are top-notch, with laboratories equipped with all needful equipment, medical facilities on campus, and more. There is a cricket cum soccer field, one basketball court, three volleyball courts, and three badminton courts.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Agricultural Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Enjoyed a lot in college!

content.Placements: On our passed-out time, there were very few placements due to COVID-19 in 2019. But after that, my next year batch got many placements from big companies like Tech Mahindra, TAFE, New Holland, etc. Most members of our batch in 2018 got internships and went to Andaman, Hyderabad, Ludhiana, Coimbatore, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good in our college. For every department, all equipment is available in the labs, and there is a big library in our college. Hostel facilities are good; rooms are free, and all are friendly. The food is also nice and very hygienic. The greenery is good in the hostel surroundings, and we have a playground as well.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Agricultural Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: You can join this college to learn good engineering.

content.Placements: Around 80% of the students got placed from our college. Top company like Mahendra and Mahendra Group is the top recruiting company. Every year around 98% of the students gets an internship. The university offers Ph.D. level courses in order to provide their best to society. It is the best college.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has one of the best libraries with world-class infrastructure. They provide an excellent hostel with good food and medical facilities. Utmost importance is given to sports. Every year there will is a college day and students practice for it. Best sports and gym equipment are available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Agricultural Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Good faculty members with good facilities.

content.Placements: Every year placement varies in my batch. 50% of placements are received, and the remaining are joined in further studies. The salary is between 3 LPA - 6 LPA. Everyone can get internships on average to top companies. Roles are marketing executive, production executive, etc. Projects and experiential learning programs are held by the student.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are available in every department and are available to everyone. Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, and computer lab are available. Hostel facilities are good. Quality of food is good. Medical clinic, sports and games with ground are available. Every year inter-college sports and games competitions are held.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Agricultural Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with good staff and placements.

content.Placements: 70% of the students are placed. 70,000 is the highest salary and 20,000 is the lowest salary. The top recruiter is Tech Mahindra. 90% of students got internships. The top roles offered are agriculture scientist and surveyor.
content.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi on the campus but not in the hostel. There are labs for each subject. There is a library and a clinic in the college. individual_reviews.title: Absolutely good environment, dissatisfied because of the placements.

content.Placements: I am a final-year student. In our college that too in the CSE department the strength is 65 only 2 of them got placed. The two students placed are by the pool campus. If they provide some training and on campus then some other students may get placed in good companies.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: My college is very good.

content.Infrastructure: They have given the following facilities in our course- Well facilitated labs, Wi-Fi, classrooms, library, and electronic devices in labs. Better chefs were in charge of the food. No problem with food. They provide unlimited food with limited mess bill. We play cricket also.
content.Faculty: The teachers were extremely helpful. They clear our doubts at any time during the College. ECE is the evergreen batch they can go either software or hardware side. It's not about difficulty; we worked hard during exam days, and 70% is the pass rate.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: There is a good infrastructure and facilities. It is a huge campus.

content.Placements: From a master of business administration of the 2021 batch, about 100% of students were placed. The highest salary package offered in our course was 15 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 2.5 LPA. IBM, Toyota, Wipro, etc., visit here for placements. About 100% of students got internships from our course.

Safety and security are assured. In every classroom, CCTV cameras are installed, and they are always operated.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Best college I ever heard of, if you find the best college in Bhopal. I recommended Bhopal.

content.Placements: Placement support in Bhopal is decent for students to stay consistent with their skills. Many students from my batch have been placed in well known companies and also received internships. Internship is also provided for students. Want to get experience.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of technocrats institute of technology is quite good for students. Classrooms are very neat and clean labs are fully equipped with gadgets. The price of the hostel is very reasonable. Their food qualities are acceptable. Basic medical facilities available for a student.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a decent college in terms of investment and ROI.

content.Placements: This college provides the best placement opportunities to students. It invites various companies to campus as compared to other colleges in Bhopal. 70-80% of students get placed in my branch. The average package offered is 3 LPA, and it is good. The highest package is 9 LPA. Companies that visit the college every year are Capgemini, TCS, and Accenture for software development and analyst roles.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is really amazing. My CSE department is well-maintained. Classrooms have a smart board. The library has a decent range of books. Lab devices are old and should be replaced with new ones. The hostel is good. Rooms and everything are well-maintained. The food quality is decent. There is no sports exposure in this college, and we can play very few games on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: College has good infrastructure with more placement help, but academics need to get better.

content.Placements: Nearly 75% of students in CSE 2025 class were placed. Packages average 5 LPA and vary from 4.5 LPA to 16 LPA. Wipro, TCS, Infosys, and Capgemini were the main recruiters. Approximately 60% were able to obtain tech internships at companies such as Accenture and Cognizant.
content.Infrastructure: CSE department has smart classrooms, contemporary labs, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a well-stocked library. Hostels are clean, provide Wi-Fi, 24-hour utilities, and serve delicious mess meals. Medical help is accessible. Sports such as cricket, tennis, and volleyball contribute to a well-rounded campus life.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Bitterly sweet life at Technocrats Institute of Technology (Excellence).

content.Placements: 60% of students got placed at the time of recession when companies were not hiring. The average package was 4-5 LPA. Top recruiters are Capgemini, Accenture, HCL, and TCS. Fewer people were into internships. Software engineer roles were given to placed students as freshers mostly in all these tech companies.
content.Infrastructure: Labs were finely maintained. The library system was not so understandable. We were not allowed to sit there. I stayed outside the college hostel. There were lots of sports organized at the annual function. The canteen was a bit small, so we had to adjust between timings.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely recommended if the budget is up to 1 to 1.5 lakhs with a good quality of education.

content.Placements: In the college, the highest package offered was 58 LPA last year. Above 70% of students get placed from each batch. My personal compliment for it is that it provides TNP classes from the first year, so it helps students to grab more packages. It offers multiple packages at the same time, which means a student can have multiple options to be placed according to their compatibility.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a top-notch campus with 4 engineering, and two autonomous colleges. It has a huge auditorium, library, gym, hostel, playground, etc. Our college has a large cafeteria. The college has a lakefront view with a beautiful environment and surroundings. It has Wi-Fi-enabled computer labs and well-integrated labs of other core branches.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college has good infrastructure.

content.Placements: About 70% of students got placed in IT companies like Technopark, UST global, Speridian and Infopark etc. The minimum salary is up to 30,000 - 750000. Students who scored more than 70% get internships from Speridian, Infopark and Technopark. Placement training is also done.
content.Infrastructure: Good and large rooms, table and lamps for studying are there. Good and fast Wi-Fi connection is there. There is a vast space for library. Hostel food is very good, and students can prefer food items. In evening, students can play football, cricket, badminton and chess till 6.30 pm.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Best college with improper management.

content.Placements: Good pass percentage and confirm placements for students with pass marks. The lowest package offered would be around two Lacs and the highest would be around 4-4 lakhs which would be nri seats. They recruit students in top IT firms in technopark and other huge IT firms like ibm, Microsoft, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is a bit old not too modern but okayish. They have a calm and composed nature and surroundings. However outside gives a pleasing appearance but the inside could be a bit more appealing. Old chairs and tables with less lightings and dull atmosphere. Canteen food quality not that great but cheap.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: It was a great college to study, develop skill, getting great placements, and enjoy.

content.Placements: Great internships and placements in good companies were provided. With skill development facilities, we were able to develop skills to increase great chances in good companies. Placement cell was connected with most of the great companies like Infosys, Jio, etc., for making students get placed at good companies.
content.Infrastructure: Our college had a wide area with good infrastructure. There was an excellent ambience in the college both for studies and enjoyment. There was a good hostel facility with a mess and a good canteen which provides good quality and healthy food. The workshop facilities and sports were great.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The college is quite good, but the faculty members need to be improved.

content.Placements: The placement opportunities offered are good. The college has tie-ups with a lot of companies located in the nearby Technopark campus. Technopark campus has almost 100-200 multinational companies, and it's India's largest IT park. The college is very good at placements and offers help to students.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is enabled with Wi-Fi facility, and we have a lot of amenities like parking space for students. The college also has a cafeteria. We have a library with almost all the books that a student needs. The library contains more than 10 copies of each book, and you can read the books for free. The college is located in an area where there is a lot of bus service available. the college also provides hostel facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Honest review from a current student.

content.Placements: I was an ongoing student, but I heard that many of my seniors got college placements in Mumbai and Hyderabad. I believe they provided good placements. They offered placements at Infosys. Companies like Technopark have high possibilities for students in the computer batch.
content.Infrastructure: The building had good infrastructure. They had a library, labs, and classrooms. They provided everything in a good manner, and everything was neat and clean. Wi-Fi was also available for the staff. Many lab assistants were available for each department, and we could ask our doubts to them as well. They were all well-educated.

review_summary.college_name: Sant Baba Bhag Singh University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I do not recommend this college to others.

content.Placements: In our course, 50% or a few students get placed in our course. The highest package offered in our course is around 4 LPA and the average package offered in our course ranges from 1-2 LPA or less. The top roles offered in our course are web developer, full stack developer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our university is very bad as well as the management. Wi-Fi is present in our university and hostel but it's very slow and barely works. Labs are present in our university but a majority of computers do not work and others are very slow.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Sant Baba Bhag Singh University, Jalandhar, is good.

content.Placements: Around 70–80% of students are placed, with the highest package of 10 LPA, the lowest 3 LPA, and an average of 4.5 LPA. The top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and Capgemini. 60% of students secured internships at companies like Cognizant, HCL, and startups, mainly in roles such as software developer, analyst, and QA engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The college offers well-equipped labs, Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, and a decent library. Facilities support practical learning, though some equipment may be outdated. The hostel rooms are basic but livable, with average food in the mess. Medical help is available on campus, and the college has good sports facilities for both indoor and outdoor games.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: This university is great.

content.Placements: More than 60% of the students were placed in our course. The highest package offered in our course is 2 - 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Shopping Minds, Solitaire Infosis, Teach Cadd, etc. Almost 80% of the students got the internship.
content.Infrastructure: In our university, the infrastructure is great and facilities are available for all the students and teachers, but hostel services and facilities are not that great. The hostel food is very basic and the same items are repeated every week. All types of sports and games are available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Hotel Management and Catering Technology (BHMCT) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A hostel is not recommended.

content.Placements: More than 70% of students got placed in our course. The highest package offered in our course ranges from 2-3 LPA and the average package offered in our course ranges from 1-1.5 LPA. The top roles offered in our course are chief, bartender, serviceman, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our department is average. Facilities like Wi-Fi, library, and well-settled classrooms are also present for students. The infrastructure of our hostel is not that great, and it is below average. The food is not good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Hotel Management and Catering Technology (BHMCT) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: A hostel is not recommended.

content.Placements: In our course more than 80 percent of the students secure placements. The highest package offered is about 2-3 LPA and the average package is approximately 1-1.5 LPA. Top recruiting hotels include The Park Hotel (New Delhi) The Sunday Hotel (Chandigarh) and others.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our department is average with facilities such as WiFi a library, and well-equipped classrooms available for all students. However, the hostel infrastructure is below average, and the food quality is also lacking.

SBBS University admissions are conducted both in online and offline mode. Candidates need first choose the course of their choice and fulfil its selection and eligibility requirements for admission. Below are the steps to get a seat in Sant Baba Bhag Singh University:
STEP 1: SBBS University Application Process 2025

Candidates can get the prospectus and application form from the university campus or apply online on the official website of SBBS. Aspirants need to pay an application fee of INR 1,000 via DD for offline submissions.
STEP 2: Selection
Applicants are shortlisted for all UG and PG programmes based on their merit in the last qualifying exam. The university conducts an entrance exam for admission to PhD programme.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation

Once the selection process is over, admission team of the university sends a confirmation mail to the selected candidates. Such aspirants will need to pay the requisite fee to confirm their seat in the university.

The seats for PhD programme is filled based on the entrance exam score. The university conducts an entrance exam to select candidates for PhD courses. Aspirants with a validUGC NET/GATE/ SLET (Punjab Only) and those who appeared in NET are exempted.

faqs.question: Are admissions open at Sant Baba Bhag Singh University?
faqs.answer: Yes, Sant Baba Bhag Singh University admissions are currently open. Candidates can apply online or collect the application offline from the campus to apply for admissions. The selection for all the UG and PG courses is based on merit in the last qualifying exam. The entrance exam scores are considered for admission to PhD course.

faqs.question: What is the Sant Baba Bhag Singh University selection criteria for BBA?
faqs.answer: Sant Baba Bhag Singh University select students for the BBA programme on a merit-basis. Hence, the applicants performance in Class 12 or equivalent examination is evaluated. There is no entrance score requirement. The candidates seeking admission must meet the below-mentioned criteria:Class 12 or equivalent pass with at least 50% aggregate (45% aggregate for SC/ ST category candidates).
